subject: Stakeholder gap map + champion fueling (next steps & procurement checklist)
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@zephyrpay.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@zephyrpay.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up from today's discovery - stakeholder list and timelines

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for carving out time today — the demo and cost discussion were helpful. A quick recap from our side and the people we think need to be looped in as we move into procurement: 

- Economic buyer: Samir Patel (CFO) — will want a 3-year TCO/ROI and loss-avoidance examples
- Security / legal: Dana Lopez (Head of InfoSec) — will validate data handling, audit logs, and encryption in transit/rest
- Procurement admin: procurement@zephyrpay.com (Samira on the vendor side) — will own contractual cadence and vendor intake
- Platform champion: Alyssa Chen (me) — will drive the POC and internal sell-in

Decision criteria we discussed: predictable per-token economics, VPC/private deployment option for PCI scope, and an SLA for latency spikes. Our tentative timeline: POC in December, procurement review mid-Jan, Exec approval by end of Jan.

Can you share a one-page champion packet + a short procurement checklist we can hand to Samir and Dana? Also, if you have a simple ROI calculator we can demo to the CFO it would be great. Attaching our discovery notes and the list of items security asked for (redacted).

Attachments: zephyrpay-discovery-notes.pdf

Thanks — Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Head of Platform Engineering, ZephyrPay
alyssa.chen@zephyrpay.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@zephyrpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery - stakeholder list and timelines

Alyssa — great notes, thanks. Quick reply with proposed next steps and who owns what: 

1) Stakeholder gap map (owner: me)
   - I'll send a short map that ties each Zephyr decision role to the evaluation criteria (security, economics, latency) and the evidence they want (benchmarks, SOC2 statement, network diagrams).

2) Champion enablement packet (owner: Marissa)
   - Marissa, can you produce a 1-page talk track + one-pager ROI summary we can send to Samir and Dana? Keep one slide CFO-focused (3-year NPV / payback) and one slide security-focused (data flows + audit artifacts).

3) ROI demo / calculator (owner: me)
   - Attaching an editable ROI workbook (redwood-roi-calculator.xlsx). I can walk Samir through a filled example in a 20-minute follow-up call.

4) Procurement checklist & legal gating (owner: Neha)
   - Neha, please draft a procurement checklist: required SLAs, data residency options, contract term suggestions, and a list of standard redlines we can accept. Include an estimate of procurement lead time.

Proposed next meeting: Dec 8, 10:00–10:30am PT — a short alignment with Samir + Dana so we can confirm the POC scope. If that works I'll send a calendar invite and include a short packet beforehand.

Attachments: redwood-roi-calculator.xlsx

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@zephyrpay.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery - stakeholder list and timelines

On Mon, Nov 15, 2026 at 11:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> 2) Champion enablement packet (owner: Marissa)

Thanks Vivek — I put together a short champion kit and talk tracks and attached them. Highlights:

- One-page champion play (champion-one-pager.pdf): elevator script, 3 ROI bullets (latency-driven revenue protection, cost per inference delta, ops time saved), and an internal agenda to run a 30-minute exec sync.
- CFO slide (excerpt): 3-year payback and sensitivity to QPS + batch rate (see notes in the ROI workbook).
- Security brief: suggested artifacts (SOC2 cert, network diagram, KMS integration doc) and a short recommended email intro you can send to Dana.

Question for Alyssa: on data residency — is ZephyrPay open to Redwood Private (customer VPC) or do you need fully on-prem? That will change the legal gating and timeline.

Attachments: champion-one-pager.pdf

I'll be ready to run the Dec 8 sync. Vivek — I'll also prepare two short internal slides you can drop into a procurement packet that list acceptable contract terms and proposed SLA language.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@zephyrpay.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@zephyrpay.com>, procurement@zephyrpay.com
Date: 2026-11-16T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery - stakeholder list and timelines

Thanks team — this is exactly what we needed. Quick updates: 

- Samir is open to Redwood Private (VPC) but wants OOB latency numbers and the 3-year TCO filled in before committing. He suggested we run a short exec-level deck first.
- Dana (Head InfoSec) asked that you send the SOC2 report, network diagram, and a sample encryption key rotation policy. Dana's email is dana.lopez@zephyrpay.com — I'll intro her on the Dec 8 call if that works.
- Procurement: Samira (procurement@zephyrpay.com) will start vendor intake when they receive the procurement packet and legal terms. She expects a 2–3 week review cycle after submission.

Linking procurement contact and an initial DocuSign NDA they prefer: https://www.docusign.com/link/ABC-XYZ-1234

Let's lock Dec 8th — 10:00am PT works. Please include the one-pager and the ROI workbook in the invite as prep materials.

Thanks, Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Head of Platform Engineering, ZephyrPay
alyssa.chen@zephyrpay.com
